title: UCD MOBILE APP — PHONE NAVIGATION BUTTONS

rows.obj: Verify holding Home for the assistant at the thumbprint step keeps the step usable.
rows.steps:
1. Read MyKad at **STMS Step 1** with Iris
2. Place thumb on the Iris reader
3. Hold **Home** (Android: Google Assistant, Gemini or Circle to Search) or hold the **side button** (iOS: Siri) while the thumb is on the reader
4. Close the assistant, place thumb again, tap **[Next]**
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 1 -> Remain on the page while the assistant is open
2. STMS Step 1 -> ++"Verification Passed"++ after the thumb is placed again
rows.rem: What opens depends on the phone setting. Whether it forces a MyKad rescan: open with the developer.

rows.obj: Verify the swipe-up Home gesture at the thumbprint step asks for a MyKad rescan on return.
rows.steps:
1. Set **gesture navigation** (Android)
2. Read MyKad at **STMS Step 1** with Iris
3. Swipe up from the bottom edge to go **Home**, reopen the app
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 1 -> "Remain on the same page - Auto refresh the page, need to rescan MyKad & redo thumbprint"

rows.exp:

rows.obj: Verify pressing the phone Back button while the thumb is on the reader acts like the in-app Back button.
rows.steps:
1. Set **3-button navigation**
2. Read MyKad at **STMS Step 3** with Iris
3. Place thumb on the Iris reader
4. Press the phone **Back** button while the thumb is on the reader
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 3 -> Same result as the in-app **Back** button
rows.rem: iPhone has no Back button: back gesture is 9805_IN_TS50.

2. Read MyKad at **STMS Step 3** with Iris
3. Place thumb on the Iris reader
4. Swipe the go-back gesture from the screen edge while the thumb is on the reader

rows.obj: Verify the phone Back button on the Login page and the Home page closes the app.
rows.steps:
1. Open the app on the **Login** page, press the phone **Back** button
2. Open the app, login, press **Back** on the **Home** page
3. Repeat with the go-back gesture
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Login page / Home page -> App !!closes!!
2. Reopen -> App opens, !!does not crash!!
rows.rem: Phase 2 rule: "Back in login page / homepage will kill the app" (EAINT-6014, Functional & Interruption Test R78).

rows.obj: Verify the phone Back button on STMS Step 2 acts like the in-app Back button.
rows.steps:
1. Fill **STMS Step 2** fields
2. Press the phone **Back** button (Android) or swipe the go-back gesture
3. Repeat with the in-app **Back** button and compare
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 2 -> Same result as the in-app **Back** button
2. Typed data -> Same as with the in-app **Back** button
rows.rem: Whether typed data is kept after Back: open.

rows.obj: Verify the phone Back button with a pop-up open keeps the app stable.
rows.steps:
1. Open the **LKM Refund** pop-up on **STMS Step 5**
2. Press the phone **Back** button (Android) or swipe the go-back gesture
3. Repeat with an error message and the session expired message open
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. STMS Step 5 -> Remain on the page
2. App -> !!does not crash or freeze!!
rows.rem: Whether Back closes the pop-up: open with the developer. Note the result here.

rows.obj: Verify Home and the app switcher on non-thumbprint pages keep the page.
rows.steps:
1. Open **STMS Transaction Listing**, **STMS Transaction Details** and **STMS Step 2** with typed data
2. On each, press **Home** (or swipe up), reopen the app
3. On each, open the **app switcher**, switch to another app, reopen
rows.exp:
Ensure:
1. Every page -> Remain on the same page
2. STMS Step 2 -> Typed data kept
rows.rem: Phase 2 rule: Home or Overview then reopen -> stay on page (EAINT-6014). Typed data on STMS Step 2: open.

rows.exp:
Ensure:

2. STMS Step 2 -> Typed data kept
